name: public-maintenance-new
js: const old = document.querySelector('[data-testid=maintenance-request-card]'); const card = old.cloneNode(true); card.querySelector('h3').textContent = 'Water under the kitchen sink'; card.querySelector('p').textContent = 'There is a puddle under the sink every morning.'; const p = card.querySelector('.priority-badge'); p.className = 'priority-badge medium'; p.textContent = 'Medium'; card.querySelector('.request-date').textContent = 'Oct 16, 2026'; old.before(card);

name: admin-maintenance-detail-new
js: const old = document.querySelector('[data-testid=maintenance-request-card].selected'); const card = old.cloneNode(true); old.classList.remove('selected'); card.querySelector('.request-title').textContent = 'Water under the kitchen sink'; card.querySelector('.request-desc').textContent = 'There is a puddle under the sink every morning.'; card.querySelector('.request-date').textContent = 'Oct 16, 2026, 9:00 AM'; old.before(card); document.querySelector('[data-testid=maintenance-detail-title]').textContent = 'Water under the kitchen sink'; document.querySelector('[data-testid=maintenance-detail-date]').textContent = 'Oct 16, 2026, 9:00 AM'; document.querySelector('[data-testid=maintenance-detail-priority]').textContent = 'Priority: Medium'; document.querySelector('[data-testid=maintenance-detail-description]').textContent = 'There is a puddle under the sink every morning.';
